Reference Guide

Discover the stones, understand their associations, and choose with intention.

THE ART OF INTENTIONAL SELECTION

Choosing Crystals for Your Assignment

What does your day require of you? Choose one or more assignments to build a crystal combination.

Energetic, zodiac and jewelry associations are symbolic practitioner traditions, not proven medical effects or promises of wealth. Never ingest minerals or make crystal-infused drinking water. Physical appearance alone cannot authenticate a stone. Birthstone reference: GIA. All crystal visuals are AI-generated representative illustrations, not authenticated specimens. Appearance varies naturally; do not use illustrations alone to authenticate a stone.
